- Task: restore whitespace splitting for scalar strings decoded into `[]string` in `internal/config/config.go`, including YAML and ENV values.
- Status: implementation complete. Scalar strings decode to `[]string` using Unicode whitespace and commas; empty strings produce an empty slice. Existing sequences and non-string values bypass the hook. The advanced fixture and focused load tests cover YAML and ENV paths.

+// stringToSliceHookFunc splits scalar strings into string slices, preserving
+// comma-separated configuration while accepting whitespace-separated values.
+func stringToSliceHookFunc() mapstructure.DecodeHookFuncType {
+	return func(from, to reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+		if from == nil || from.Kind() != reflect.String || to != reflect.TypeOf([]string{}) {
+			return data, nil
+		}
+
+		return strings.FieldsFunc(reflect.ValueOf(data).String(), func(r rune) bool {
+			return unicode.IsSpace(r) || r == ','
+		}), nil
+	}
+}

+func TestStringToSliceHookFunc(t *testing.T) {
+	type originString string
+
+	stringSlice := reflect.TypeOf([]string{})
+	hook := stringToSliceHookFunc()
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		input  interface{}
+		target reflect.Type
+		want   interface{}
+	}{
+		{
+			name:   "whitespace and commas",
+			input:  " \tfoo.com  bar.com\n\tbaz.com,qux.com \r\n",
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com", "qux.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "empty string",
+			input:  "",
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "named string type",
+			input:  originString("foo.com bar.com"),
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{"foo.com", "bar.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "whitespace only",
+			input:  " \t\n ",
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "sequence",
+			input:  []string{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"},
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "untyped sequence",
+			input:  []interface{}{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"},
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []interface{}{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "non-string source",
+			input:  42,
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   42,
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "nil source",
+			input:  nil,
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   nil,
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "other target",
+			input:  "foo.com bar.com",
+			target: reflect.TypeOf([]int{}),
+			want:   "foo.com bar.com",
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			got, err := hook(reflect.TypeOf(tt.input), tt.target, tt.input)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, got)
+		})
+	}
+}

+func TestLoadAllowedOrigins(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name string
+		yaml string
+		want []string
+	}{
+		{
+			name: "mixed whitespace",
+			yaml: "cors:\n  allowed_origins: \"  foo.com\\tbar.com\\n baz.com  \"\n",
+			want: []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "empty string",
+			yaml: "cors:\n  allowed_origins: \"\"\n",
+			want: []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name: "YAML sequence",
+			yaml: "cors:\n  allowed_origins:\n    - \"foo.com bar.com\"\n    - baz.com\n",
+			want: []string{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			path := t.TempDir() + "/config.yml"
+			require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(path, []byte(tt.yaml), 0600))
+
+			cfg, err := Load(path)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			assert.Equal(t, tt.want, cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+		})
+	}
+
+	t.Run("ENV mixed whitespace", func(t *testing.T) {
+		t.Setenv("FLIPT_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS", "  foo.com\tbar.com\n baz.com  ")
+		cfg, err := Load("./testdata/default.yml")
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		assert.Equal(t, []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"}, cfg.Cors.AllowedOrigins)
+	})
+}
